column6: Derive isTablet from the same BuildContext/MediaQuery passed into OnboardingMetrics.of (e.g. MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).shortestSide, as SplashMetrics already does correctly) instead of a global static, or ensure setDeviceType is re-invoked on every relevant rebuild/metrics query.
